role: The EntityZombie kind (constructor, child, onSpawnWithEgg with armour, weapon, enchantments and the spawn-bonus modifiers, daylight burning, attackEntityAsMob, drops), EntityLiving's canPickUpLoot pass shared by the hostiles, the probe's stand-in player (constructor, food stats, item pickup), hostile_spawn that constructs every hostile kind in the probe's list order, and hostile_write_state, the per-entity state record compared against the oracle's hostile dumps.
gpu: line 278, function hostile_loot_update: fixed 32-entry item query; results depend on the entity query's container order
line 345, function hostile_loot_update: an_spawn_item heap-allocates the dropped entity inside the tick
function hostile_loot_update: the picked-up stack is shared by a stack_link (the item's pool slot, whose record the pool keeps after release, or a living's equipment slot by lref) (lane/gpuarena, L3)
line 432, function zombie_drop_few_items: an_spawn_item per drop (heap allocation in the tick)
line 459, function player_construct: on_living_update function pointer
lines 582 and 704, function hostile_spawn: calloc of the living and its an_ent
line 603, function hostile_spawn: an->player pointer to the stand-in player
line 780 and 808, function hostile_write_state: linear scans of the AI task list for the arrow-attack and attack-on-collide tasks
notes: The player here is a probe stand-in built as a living (HK_PLAYER), not the real EntityPlayerMP; its item pickup merges stacks into 36 slots without InventoryPlayer's exact slot order being verified. zombie_on_spawn_with_egg draws the chicken-jockey rolls but spawns no chicken jockey (lines 110-117 are empty branches). Zombie villager conversion state is carried elsewhere (living.c NBT, serverreplay.c), not here. hostile_loot_update is declared twice in hostiles.h. Java member names for EntityLiving and EntityPlayer were inferred from the C comments and structure, not checked one by one. Evidence recordings: out/java/hostiles, and the fight-zombie-s1 snapshot for the zombie. Possible divergence seen while reading, not tested: zombie_on_living_update draws nextInt(2) for any helmet, while Java's EntityZombie only draws when the helmet isItemStackDamageable. lane/idxentity: the loot pickup over both item pools with the held-item modifier and diamondsToYou; the sun helmet's isItemStackDamageable and renderBrokenItemStack (mob_sun_helmet, the zombie's and the skeleton's).
